svg.title: How Gantry fits together
svg.desc: Each browser runs the Gantt and its scheduling engine and talks to Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Realtime, Storage, Edge Functions). The assistant service on Fly.io reads and writes through Supabase, runs Claude, and reads PayPal. Edge Functions pay the crews and send invoices through PayPal. The call runs on LiveKit: Vercel functions hand out tokens and bring Remy in, and her call worker hears each person through OpenAI and speaks through OpenAI or ElevenLabs.
svg.text: The hosted site runs on Vercel, Supabase, Fly.io and LiveKit Cloud. A local build runs the same pieces on your machine, with the Vite dev server in Vercel’s place.
Remy in the chat, with her own cursor
Changes go out as numbered revisions
the host’s tab hands Remy her lines,
one agent per project, one turn at a time
signs each line she will speak
Agent Toolkit: Remy reads, never pays
the app asks where each payment stands
hears each person on their own track
speaks only lines the service signed
Sonnet 5.5 for replies · Opus 5.5 for analysis
audio · what she heard · her signed lines
On the hosted site, words said to Remy go from the speaker’s tab into the conversation; her answers go from the assistant service over Realtime to the host’s tab,
which hands them, signed, to her call worker. The assistant service and the call worker never connect directly. Every payment runs in PayPal’s sandbox.
